name: Unavailable YOLO model produces an honest failed analysis run
description: When the model checkpoint is not configured, the run reaches a visible failed state with an actionable error and no fabricated detection output.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Media Traffic application running without a configured YOLO model checkpoint.
Upload the synthetic demo video at example/demo-traffic-video/source.mp4.
Open the scene configuration for the uploaded video.
Wait until the analysis run reaches a terminal state.
In the saved run records panel, verify the run is labeled failed and shows the actionable missing YOLO model configuration message.
Verify no completed vehicle-track count, detection boxes, or fabricated analysis result appears for the failed run.
